convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorJFatl custom indicator which requires JFatl.mq5 and JJRSX.mq5 custom indicator files. ReOpen logic adds complexity. Digit adjustment logic is present but straightforward.

other_exits: ReOpen logic: closes existing position and re-opens in same direction when signal reconfirms on new bar, allowing position refresh at current price

position_sizing.conditional_logic: LotSize input parameter controls fixed lot size; negative values may indicate risk-based sizing in some variants

custom_logic_notes: ReOpen feature: when already in a position and the signal persists on a new bar, the EA closes the existing position and opens a fresh one at the current price, resetting SL/TP levels. ColorJFatl is a color-changing trend line based on Jurik filtering that changes color on trend direction change. The digit adjustment mechanism multiplies SL/TP/Trailing values by 10 when the broker uses 5-digit (3-digit for JPY) pricing to maintain consistent pip values.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement JFatl (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) and JJRSX (Jurik RSI) custom indicators in Python. The JFatl indicator uses Jurik smoothing which requires the JMA algorithm implementation. Digit adjustment logic is standard (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers). The ReOpen logic requires tracking position open time and comparing with bar time to detect new bars while maintaining signal direction. CSignalJFatl class from MQL5 Standard Library may serve as reference for the indicator logic.
